scope: READONLY diff review of skill_prepare.rs formatting/validation layer
commands_executed: strings skill-tests | grep test_names (verify tests compiled in)

no_fake_filesystem_authorization.evidence: Line 1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]. Lines 3-6: explicit disclaim that filesystem authorization and no-follow traversal belong to broker-owned SkillSourceReader. Module only validates returned data.

output_cap_enforced.evidence: add_len (lines 108-112) uses checked_add, enforces MAX_SKILL_OUTPUT_BYTES (112KB) BEFORE writing. No silent truncation. debug_assert_eq on line 147 verifies output length matches computed.

metadata_validation.evidence: valid_metadata (lines 88-91) rejects control chars, DEL, and XML metacharacters (< > " &) when markup=true. Applied to id, name (markup=true), description (markup=false).

directory_validation.evidence: valid_directory (lines 93-95) additionally rejects newline and carriage return. Prevents newline injection in Base directory text field.

related_path_validation.evidence: valid_related_path (lines 97-106) rejects: empty, >4096 bytes, backslash, leading /, colon, control chars, DEL, XML metacharacters, and . / .. segments. Paths inserted raw into <file> wrappers so delimiter rejection is correct.

reader_error_propagation.evidence: prepare_skill returns errors from reader.read_skill() and reader.related_files() directly. Test reader_denial_is_propagated_without_fallback (line 180) confirms PermissionDenied is not downgraded.

traversal_gating.evidence: related_files only invoked when source_basename == 'SKILL.md' (line 124). Non-SKILL.md basename skips traversal entirely. Test non_skill_md_never_walks_related_files confirms.

content_size_bound.evidence: Line 121: read.content.len() checked against MAX_SKILL_CONTENT_BYTES (96KB) before UTF-8 conversion.

related_count_bound.evidence: Line 126: entries.len() checked against MAX_RELATED_FILES (10). Test reader_over_returning_max_files_is_typed_exhaustion confirms Entries exhaustion.

no_related_body_reads.evidence: Candidate only collects AuthorizedRelatedFile.path strings. Does not read file bodies. Matches v2 reader behavior (reader line 224: 'We do NOT read its body').

unresolved_issues.description: PrepareError variant mismatch: candidate enum has ReaderContractViolation but reader v2 uses SymlinkRejected, NotRegularFile, Io
unresolved_issues.security_impact: none - prepare layer propagates any PrepareError without fallback

unresolved_issues.description: Not yet integrated into crates/tools/src/lib.rs module tree

comparisons.skill_gate_rs: Consistent pattern - lexical validation + no-follow opens + owner-only permissions + create_new to prevent overwrites
comparisons.skill_reader_v1_defects: v1 had absolute openat(-1), unnecessary body reads, budget-after-alloc. v2 reader fixes these. Candidate correctly does not read bodies.
